beats.say: This bottle of water knocked Brazil out of a World Cup.
The Argentine physio runs on, and Branco asks for a drink.
Minutes later he can barely stand.
Argentina win one nil. Brazil go home.
Years later Maradona admitted it on TV. The water was spiked.
